summary: Ellenberg–Venkatesh–Westerland prove homological stability for Hurwitz spaces of nonsplitting pairs (G, c) (Theorem 6.1) and its version for Hurwitz schemes. They deduce that the ℓ-parts of class groups of imaginary quadratic extensions of F_q(t) approach the Cohen–Lenstra distribution as q → ∞ (Theorem 1.2). Complete (cc-442dc5): every numbered statement is an item, every missing item is routed, and nineteen findings are recorded. Theorem 1.2 is established only along odd q prime to ℓ, not for all q ≢ 1 (mod ℓ) as printed (E11). Not formalised.

items.name: Singular chain and homology functors
items.statement: For a coefficient object in a preadditive category with coproducts, singular chains are obtained from the singular simplicial set; when homology exists, singular homology is a functor of spaces.

items.name: Artin braid group carrier
items.statement: The n-strand braid group is the Artin group of the A_(n−1) Coxeter matrix, with n−1 generators, adjacent braid relations and distant commutation; its universal map is determined by images satisfying those relations.

items.name: Conjugation quandle
items.statement: For a group G, the conjugation quandle operation is x ◃ y = xyx^{-1}. This is the positive Hurwitz-move operation, whereas EVW's exponent notation is g^h=h^{-1}gh.

items.name: Monoid algebra carrier
items.statement: For a semiring k and monoid S, MonoidAlgebra k S consists of finitely supported k-coefficients with convolution. For commutative k and a k-algebra B, monoid maps S→B extend uniquely to algebra maps.

items.name: Spectral sequence carrier
items.statement: In an abelian category C, a spectral sequence with chosen complex shapes consists of pages and specified identifications of each page's homology with the next page; this alone supplies no filtration, convergence or EVW differential.

items.name: Semidirect product carrier
items.statement: Given groups N,H and an action H→Aut(N), SemidirectProduct N H has multiplication (n,h)(n',h')=(n·h(n'),hh'), canonical inclusions and quotient to H.

items.name: Symplectic matrix carrier
items.statement: For a commutative ring R and finite index set I, symplecticGroup I R comprises matrices preserving the standard alternating matrix J by A J Aᵀ=J. No general GSp multiplier-orbit theorem is included in this claim.

items.statement: For q odd, ell∤q, A nontrivial finite abelian ell-group and n odd, X_n(F_q) is in bijection with isomorphism classes of (L,alpha) in item 84. The inverse builds the generalized-dihedral extension from the class-field quotient, with the correct inertia and connectedness.

items.statement: Under item 87, sum_(L∈S_n)|Sur(Cl(O_L),A)|=2|X_n(F_q)|. Inversion acts freely on nontrivial surjections for odd ell; A=1 is handled separately and has moment exactly one.

items.statement: For q odd and odd n≥3, |S_n|=2(q^n−q^(n−1)), from monic squarefree polynomials and the two square classes of nonzero constants. For n=1, |S_1|=2q, not 2(q−1).

items.name: Empirical ell-primary class-group law
items.statement: Define nu_n(A)=|{L∈S_n:Cl(O_L)_ell is isomorphic to A}|/|S_n|. This is a probability measure on L; using the whole class group instead of its ell-primary part does not define this measure.

items.name: Compactly supported etale duality
items.statement: For smooth separated finite-type X/F_q of pure dimension n and coefficient prime L∤q, H_c^j(Xbar,Q_L) pairs perfectly with H^(2n−j)(Xbar,Q_L(n)), compatibly with Frobenius. In particular their dimensions agree.

items.name: Upper weight bound
items.statement: For separated finite-type X/F_q and L∤q, eigenvalues of geometric Frobenius on H_c^j(Xbar,Q_L) with constant coefficients have all complex absolute values at most q^(j/2). Purity is not claimed for arbitrary nonproper cohomology.

items.name: Rational-point trace formula
items.statement: For separated finite-type X/F_q and L∤q, |X(F_q)|=sum_j (−1)^j Tr(Frob_geom|H_c^j(Xbar,Q_L)). Import the existing trace-formula integration owner rather than inventing an etale-cohomology package here.

items.name: Top cohomology counts Frobenius-fixed components
items.statement: For smooth pure n-dimensional X/F_q, H_c^(2n)(Xbar,Q_L) is the permutation representation of geometric connected components with twist (−n). Its normalized Frobenius trace is the number of fixed components, not the total number of components.

items.name: Uniform trace-error estimate
items.statement: If exactly one geometric component is Frobenius-fixed and dim H^i≤C^(i+1), then for sqrt(q)>C, |q^(−n)|X(F_q)|−1|≤sum_(i≥1) C^(i+1)q^(−i/2)=C²/(sqrt(q)−C). Use the finite cohomological range before extending the positive bound to the infinite geometric series.

items.name: Hyperelliptic torsion local system
items.statement: Over the squarefree odd-degree polynomial family, the smooth projective curve y²=f(x) has genus g=(n−1)/2 and Jacobian ell^k-torsion V of rank 2g over Z/ell^k. Its Weil pairing is perfect alternating with cyclotomic multiplier; geometric monodromy is symplectic and arithmetic Frobenius has multiplier q.
items.note: Use the monic representative of the affine configuration polynomial. The general arithmetic/geometric image quotient need not equal its cyclotomic multiplier image without the full-geometric-Sp hypothesis; item137 states the correct exact sequence. The full family image is proved in item116 only in its stated range.

items.name: Integral hyperelliptic monodromy input
items.statement: Over algebraically closed k with 2ell invertible, both labelled and unlabelled hyperelliptic moduli have mod-ell monodromy Sp_(2g)(F_ell), g≥1 (Achter–Pries Theorem3.4). Their integral images are Sp_(2g)(Z_ell) when g≥2, or when g=1 and ell≥5, by Vasiu Theorem1.3. The cited lifting argument at (g,ell)=(1,3) additionally needs a nonzero first congruence kernel; that exceptional proof is not supplied here.

items.name: Monodromy orbits and arithmetic components
items.statement: Connected components of a finite etale cover over a geometrically connected base are geometric fundamental-group orbits on its generic fibre. A component is F_q-defined precisely when Frobenius preserves that orbit. Since −I∈Sp(V), passing Sur(V,A)→Sur(V,A)/± does not change the symplectic orbit set.

items.name: Symplectic similitudes on an ell-adic lattice
items.statement: For a finite free Z_ell-module V with perfect alternating pairing omega, GSp(V) consists of automorphisms h with omega(hx,hy)=mult(h)omega(x,y), where mult(h) is a unit. Its kernel is Sp(V); GSp_q is the multiplier-q coset.

items.name: Orthogonality and a killed Lagrangian
items.statement: In item 101, V_1 and V_q are isotropic, V_1⊕V_q is orthogonal to nondegenerate W, and W has a decomposition into complementary isotropic summands. If f h=f, then ker f contains a Lagrangian, namely V_q⊕W_- after such a decomposition.

items.name: Symplectic integral normal forms
items.statement: A perfect alternating lattice over Z_ell has a symplectic basis; Sp acts transitively on Lagrangian direct summands, complementary Lagrangians have equal rank, and every automorphism of one Lagrangian extends via inverse transpose on its complement to a symplectic automorphism.

items.name: Linear group acts transitively on lattice surjections
items.statement: For finite abelian ell-group A generated by at most g elements, GL_g(Z_ell) acts transitively on surjections Z_ell^g→A. Lift a fixed minimal generating set, extend it modulo ell to a basis, and alter the remaining g−k basis vectors to lie in the kernel.

items.name: Unique similitude-stable symplectic orbit
items.statement: If ell∤q(q−1), Sp(V) acts transitively on the surjections f:V→A for which some h∈GSp_q(V) satisfies f h=f. Such f exist when g≥dim_Fell(A/ell A), by projection to a Lagrangian and a diagonal multiplier-q map.

items.name: One rational geometric Hurwitz component eventually
items.statement: For n odd sufficiently large relative to A and ell∤q(q−1), exactly one geometric connected component of X_n is fixed by Frobenius. Combine full hyperelliptic monodromy, the corrected generic fibre and the unique stable orbit theorem.

items.name: Uniform function-field surjection-moment estimate
items.statement: For each finite abelian odd-ell group A there is B(A) such that, for q odd with ell∤q(q−1), sqrt(q)>B(A), and odd n>B(A), the average over S_n of |Sur(Cl(O_L),A)| differs from 1 by at most B(A)/sqrt(q). For A=1 the difference is zero.

items.name: Positive proportions of divisible and indivisible class numbers
items.statement: For fixed odd ell and sufficiently large allowed q, positive lower proportions of the imaginary quadratic family have class number divisible by ell and positive lower proportions have class number prime to ell. Use the positive CL masses and a nontrivial ell-group, rather than claiming a fixed-q exact distribution.

items.name: Cellular comparison and finite cell homology bounds
items.statement: For an actual finite CW model, cellular chains compare naturally with singular homology and the dimension of each homology group over a field is bounded by the number of cells in that degree. EVW's specific Salvetti model is additional input.

items.name: Finite regular-cover homology descent
items.statement: For a regular finite G-cover, the Cartan–Leray spectral sequence computes quotient homology from group homology with coefficients. If |G| is invertible in the coefficient field, it reduces to coinvariants; this is distinct from the nonfree locally constant stabilizer adapter of item 59.

items.name: Cohen–Lenstra contraction constant
items.statement: For ell≥3, c_ell>1/2: finite products are strictly larger than 1−sum ell^(−i) with a fixed positive second-order margin persisting in the limit. Consequently beta=c_ell^(−1)−1<1, as required by the uniqueness iteration.

items.name: Failure of arbitrary pointwise lifting
items.statement: For X=A'=C9×C3, A=C3² and pi(x,y)=(x mod 3,y), the surjection f(x,y)=(y,x mod 3) has no lift X→A' through pi. Thus the pointwise claim used in Lemma 8.4 is false even though the aggregate inequality holds.

items.name: Distribution convergence alone does not force moment convergence
items.statement: With nu_n=(1−ell^(−n))mu+ell^(−n)delta_((C_ell)^n), nu_n→mu in total variation, but its C_ell-surjection moment is 2−2ell^(−n), tending to 2. This is an abstract probability counterexample, not a counterexample about number-field class groups.

items.name: Center-free descent for tame covers
items.statement: For a tame G-cover over an algebraically closed field, its field of moduli admits a model when Z(G)=1; the G-equivariant model over that field is unique up to isomorphism. The central obstruction lives in H² of Z(G).

items.name: Tame deformation with moving branch points
items.statement: Over an Artin local base with fixed residue cover, a tame cover has a unique deformation for a given compatible deformation of its branch divisor, in the setting and equivalence category of RW06 Proposition 4.5. This is the local etaleness input, not a general assertion for wild covers.

items.name: Hyperelliptic boundary degeneration input
items.statement: For g≥3, labeled hyperelliptic moduli meets a boundary configuration with components of genera 1,g−2,1; the prime-to-characteristic torsion of Pic^0 splits accordingly. These two overlapping decompositions embed the relevant smaller symplectic monodromy groups.
items.locator: Achter–Pries §§2.1–2.5, Lemma2.5 and Lemma3.1; Theorem3.4 proof

items.name: Overlapping symplectic subgroups generate
items.statement: In the setting of Achter–Pries Lemma 3.1, the two symplectic block subgroups obtained from the overlapping genus decompositions generate the full finite symplectic group. Together with the genus-one and genus-two base cases this gives full mod-ell hyperelliptic monodromy.

items.name: Integral lift of full mod-ell monodromy
items.statement: Let H be a closed subgroup of Sp_(2g)(Z_ell), ell odd, surjecting onto Sp_(2g)(F_ell). Then H is the whole group if g≥2 or ell≥5. For g=1,ell=3, Vasiu1.3(b) requires H mod9 to intersect the first congruence kernel nontrivially. Surjectivity modulo3 alone is insufficient: the inverse image of the order24 subgroup of SL2(Z/9) generated by [[0,1],[8,0]] and [[1,7],[6,7]] is a proper closed subgroup of index27 that still surjects modulo3.

items.name: Universal-coefficient dimension comparison
items.statement: For the proper finiteness hypotheses on geometric etale cohomology used in Proposition 7.8, rational L-adic Betti dimension is at most the number of generators of integral cohomology, which is at most mod-L cohomology dimension by the universal-coefficient sequence. This is a rank inequality, not a mod-L/rational isomorphism.

items.name: Lift histogram for the enlargement counterexample
items.statement: In item 114, among the 48 surjections X→C3², 36 have no homomorphic lift through pi and 12 have exactly 9 lifts; Aut(C9×C3) has order 108. Thus the aggregate count 108≥2·48 coexists with failure of pointwise lifting.

The map U→[U/B] is representable, smooth and surjective; its pullback to any T-point is the corresponding B-torsor. Retain stabilizers, including ineffective central subgroups.

items.name: Lifted affine coordinate group for an odd-degree double cover
items.statement: For odd n≥3 over Z[1/2], B_n consists of triples (a,b,d) with a,d units and d²=a^n. Multiplication is (a,b,d)(a′,b′,d′)=(aa′,b+ab′,dd′). It acts on ordered roots by a_i↦aa_i+b and on the curve by (x,y)↦(ax+b,dy).

items.statement: For n odd, (b,t)↦(t²,b,t^n) is an isomorphism Ga⋊Gm≃B_n, with group law (b,t)(b′,t′)=(b+t²b′,tt′). The inverse is (a,b,d)↦(b,d a^(-(n−1)/2)). Thus B_n is smooth with geometrically connected fibres.

The last label is distinguished. The curve y²=prod(x−a_i), completed smoothly, gives a map PConf_n(A¹)→Htilde_g^sm with the last label at infinity. items.name: Connected smooth torsors preserve the full fundamental-group image
items.statement: For a connected locally noetherian DM stack X and a representable smooth surjection f:U→X with geometrically connected nonempty fibres, U is connected and pi1(U)→pi1(X) is surjective. In particular this holds for a torsor under a smooth geometrically connected group.

items.name: Restriction to the smooth hyperelliptic locus preserves monodromy
items.statement: A nonempty dense open immersion into a connected normal locally noetherian DM stack induces a surjection on etale pi1. Apply this to the smooth-curve locus inside the compact-type locus on which AP defines the Jacobian abelian scheme; its mod-ell and ell-adic monodromy image is unchanged.

items.name: Full monodromy for the labelled hyperelliptic stack modulo ell
items.statement: For g≥1, ell odd and algebraically closed k of characteristic prime to2ell, the labelled and unlabelled hyperelliptic families have mod-ell geometric image Sp_(2g)(F_ell). Keep the labelled version: it permits a direct comparison with ordered affine roots.

items.name: Finite torsion-level monodromy in the exact polynomial family
items.statement: In the range of item116, for each k≥1 the geometric image on the Jacobian ell^k-torsion is Sp_(2g)(Z/ell^k). The integral symplectic group surjects to every finite level by smoothness, and the representation is the reduction of the integral Tate-module representation.

items.name: Trace-zero normal form for a branched double cover
items.statement: With2 invertible, a finite flat degree2 cover is locally the algebra O⊕L^(-1), where L is a line bundle and multiplication on the trace-zero summand is a section s of L². In the smooth hyperelliptic case the reduced branch divisor is div(s). Over a labelled genus-zero quotient with a distinguished branch section, etale-local trivializations yield y²=lambda prod(x−a_i), with lambda a unit and infinity the remaining branch point.
items.locator: Underlying cover algebra for item131; imports line-bundle/curve foundations from SF.3

items.name: Arithmetic monodromy quotient and the cyclotomic multiplier
items.statement: Let S be geometrically connected over F and let a principally polarized abelian scheme give arithmetic and geometric ell-adic images A and G. The multiplier induces an exact sequence 1→(A∩Sp)/G→A/G→chi_ell(G_F)→1. If G=Sp, the left kernel is trivial. Without this hypothesis A/G need not be the cyclotomic image.
items.locator: AP§3.1, PDF p.10; corrected input for EVW8.8 and AP Corollary3.6
